title: The Lawnmower Loop
subtitle: Henry leads Leo around the quiet side of the yard.

levels.title: Ball Behind the Marigolds
levels.clue: Leo borrowed Henry's ball—and the mower just started across the yard.

levels.title: The Quiet Edge
levels.clue: Match beside the glowing leaf so Henry can show Leo the quiet way.

levels.title: Past the Flowerpots
levels.clue: Henry leads past the marigolds while the mower loops far away.

levels.title: Grass-Clipping Gust
levels.clue: A puff of clippings rolls by. Henry stays between Leo and the noise.

levels.title: Henry Leads the Way
levels.clue: Follow Henry's leafy trail along the quiet side of the lawn.

levels.title: Leo Freezes
levels.clue: The mower sounds close. Henry gives a gentle bark to get Leo moving.

levels.title: Around the Hydrangeas
levels.clue: The long way is the calm way. Keep following Henry's safe leaves.

levels.title: The Orange Ball
levels.clue: The ball tumbles free, but Henry will not leave Leo behind.

levels.title: Almost Back to Mom
levels.clue: Mom is waiting by the gate. Henry knows the safest loop home.

levels.title: Home Along the Hedge
levels.clue: One last quiet stretch, then the brothers can bring the ball back together.
